# Hunter Foo Media

> Hunter Foo Media (legal name: HF Media Solution, Malaysia business registration IP0633909-U) is an AI agency in Kuala Lumpur for businesses in Malaysia and Singapore. We ease your company's anxiety about AI and help you keep pace with AI. We offer five services: (1) AI Consulting | Forward Deployed Engineer style: we work like a Forward Deployed Engineer embedded in your company and advise where AI fits, what to do first and how, with one consulting meeting a month (hands-on implementation optional, by quote); (2) Website building: RM399; (3) Website maintenance + Google Business Profile management: RM499/month; (4) Social media management: 2 posts a week (caption and image, 8 posts a month) plus 2 AI reels (15 seconds) a month (by quote); (5) Customized AI system: for example an AI knowledge base that answers from your company documents, workflows, a call system and calendar scheduling (by quote). The six digital employees are: Website AI, Marketing AI and Customer Service AI (serving your customers), and Clerk AI, Manager AI and PA AI (helping your team). Anything that goes out to customers is approved by a person first. Not a recruitment agency. Founder: Hunter Foo.

- Website: https://www.hunterfoomedia.com/ (English) · https://www.hunterfoomedia.com/zh/ (中文) · https://www.hunterfoomedia.com/ms/ (Bahasa Melayu)

- Service area: Malaysia, Singapore (same service, delivered remotely)
- Fees: website building: Basic RM399; SEO + AEO/GEO one-time add-on +RM994 (RM1,393 total), on the website design page; website maintenance + Google Business Profile management RM499/month. These are founding-client prices for the first 5 clients, in exchange for an honest testimonial, and will go up after 5 clients. AI consulting, maintenance of digital employees, social media management and customized AI systems are by written quote.
